images.filename: Richmond Boulevard Bridge; NB Toll Booths.jpg
images.caption: Toll booths on the north side of the Boulevard Bridge (a.k.a., "Nickel Bridge") over the James River, in the Byrd Park section of Richmond, Virginia. Virginia State Route 161 still exists on this side and continues through parts of Northern Richmond. As rustic as this toll booth appears, this toll plaza is not an original structure. Also the tolls for this bridge are still 35 cents, despite the nickname.
images.alt: Toll booths on the north side of the Boulevard Bridge (a.k.a., "Nickel Bridge") over the James River, in the Byrd Park section of Richmond, Virginia.
